find_internal_python_modules: find all internal Python submodules under a given root module excluding _src modules
get_public_symbols: get all public symbols from chex submodules by collecting names listed in each module __all__
CoverageCheck_finish: run the sphinx coverage check builder to verify all public symbols are documented in api.rst
CoverageCheck_write: run the sphinx coverage check builder write step which produces no output files
setup_sphinx_builder: register the CoverageCheck builder with a sphinx application and return version and parallel_read_safe config
